name: Big-five 2023/24 ranked-environment Plan B replication
purpose: Independent historical replication of the frozen weekend workflow, with Plan B as the primary candidate track.

environment_ranking.qualifying_rank: Top five ranked comparable environments within each Saturday/Sunday weekend.
environment_ranking.tier_C: Rank and save, but do not generate selections.
environment_ranking.excluded: Do not rank teams lacking at least five comparable matches or two venue-history matches.

candidate_A: Confirmed home starter; five previous same-player/same-team starts within 180 days; top two eligible home shooters by average shots; prior average minutes >=70; at least four of five prior starts with 2+ shots.
candidate_B: Candidate A plus prior five-start average shots >=3 and average minutes >=80.
primary_result: Candidate B 2+ total-shots hit rate, sample size, weekend consistency and streaks.
secondary_result: Candidate A comparison only; no threshold changes.
outcome: Player records at least two total shots in the target match.
decision_policy: No changes to dates, leagues, weights, rank cutoff, confidence gate, histories, player filters, exclusions or ordering after acquisition.
limits: Retrospective historical validation uses actual starting lineups as if known before kickoff.
FotMob definitions may differ from StatsBomb and must retain provider provenance.
No historical market odds or profitability claims.
Multiple players and fixtures within a weekend are correlated.
The four-week sample cannot by itself establish a future win rate.
